mapper.sql:
from corporate_customer c left join ( select r1.customer_no_snapshot, r1.rating_no, r1.rating_level, r1.rating_date from corporate_rating r1 join ( select customer_no_snapshot, max(id) as id from corporate_rating where rating_status = 'APPROVED' and deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) r2 on r1.id = r2.id ) r on r.customer_no_snapshot = c.customer_no left join ( select l1.customer_no_snapshot, l1.limit_no, l1.total_limit_amount, l1.available_limit_amount from corporate_credit_limit l1 join ( select customer_no_snapshot, max(id) as id from corporate_credit_limit where limit_status = 'ACTIVE' and deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) l2 on l1.id = l2.id ) l on l.customer_no_snapshot = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no_snapshot, count(*) as application_count, sum(apply_amount) as application_amount_total, max(id) as latest_application_id from corporate_credit_application where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) app on app.customer_no_snapshot = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_application app_latest on app_latest.id = app.latest_application_id left join ( select customer_no_snapshot, count(*) as contract_count, sum(contract_amount) as contract_amount_total, max(id) as latest_contract_id from corporate_credit_contract where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) ct on ct.customer_no_snapshot = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_contract ct_latest on ct_latest.id = ct.latest_contract_id left join ( select customer_no_snapshot, count(*) as drawdown_count, sum(actual_draw_amount) as actual_draw_amount_total, sum(outstanding_principal_amount) as outstanding_principal_amount_total, max(id) as latest_drawdown_id from corporate_credit_drawdown where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) dr on dr.customer_no_snapshot = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_drawdown dr_latest on dr_latest.id = dr.latest_drawdown_id left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as collateral_count, sum(appraisal_value) as appraisal_value_total, sum(confirmed_value) as confirmed_value_total, max(id) as latest_collateral_id from corporate_credit_collateral where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no ) co on co.customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_collateral co_latest on co_latest.id = co.latest_collateral_id left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as contract_collateral_count, sum(secured_amount) as total_secured_amount from corporate_credit_contract_collateral where deleted_flag = 0 and relation_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) rel on rel.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as exposure_count, sum(exposure_balance) as exposure_balance_total, sum(ead_amount) as ead_amount_total, max(pd) as max_pd, max(lgd_avg) as max_lgd_avg, max(lgd_downturn) as max_lgd_downturn, sum(el_avg) as el_avg_total, max(id) as latest_exposure_id from corporate_risk_exposure where deleted_flag = 0 and exposure_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) ex on ex.customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_risk_exposure ex_latest on ex_latest.id = ex.latest_exposure_id left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as overdue_count, sum(total_overdue_amount) as overdue_total_amount, max(overdue_days) as overdue_max_days, max(id) as latest_overdue_id from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no ) ov on ov.customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_overdue ov_latest on ov_latest.id = ov.latest_overdue_id left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as debt_default_count, sum(default_principal_amount) as default_principal_amount_total, sum(default_exposure_amount) as default_exposure_amount_total, min(case default_level when 'A' then 1 when 'B' then 2 when 'C' then 3 else 9 end) as highest_default_rank, max(id) as latest_debt_default_id from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and default_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) dd on dd.customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_debt_default dd_latest on dd_latest.id = dd.latest_debt_default_id left join ( select cd1.customer_no, cd1.customer_default_no, cd1.default_status, cd1.active_default_debt_count, cd1.total_default_debt_count, cd1.highest_default_level, cd1.latest_default_date from corporate_customer_default cd1 join ( select customer_no, max(id) as id from corporate_customer_default where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no ) cd2 on cd1.id = cd2.id ) cd_latest on cd_latest.customer_no = c.customer_no where c.deleted_flag = 0
and ( c.customer_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.customer_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(r.rating_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(l.limit_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(app_latest.application_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(ct_latest.contract_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(dr_latest.drawdown_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(co_latest.collateral_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(ov_latest.overdue_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(dd_latest.debt_default_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(cd_latest.customer_default_no, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
select c.id, c.customer_no, c.customer_name as customer_name_snapshot, c.status as customer_status, c.risk_level as customer_risk_level, c.owner_org_name, c.relationship_manager_name, ifnull(r.rating_no, '') as rating_no, r.rating_level, r.rating_date, ifnull(l.limit_no, '') as limit_no, ifnull(l.total_limit_amount, 0) as total_limit_amount, ifnull(l.available_limit_amount, 0) as available_limit_amount, ifnull(app.application_count, 0) as application_count, ifnull(app.application_amount_total, 0) as application_amount_total, ifnull(app_latest.application_no, '') as latest_application_no, ifnull(ct.contract_count, 0) as contract_count, ifnull(ct.contract_amount_total, 0) as contract_amount_total, ifnull(ct_latest.contract_no, '') as latest_contract_no, ifnull(dr.drawdown_count, 0) as drawdown_count, ifnull(dr.actual_draw_amount_total, 0) as actual_draw_amount_total, ifnull(dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 0) as outstanding_principal_amount_total, ifnull(dr_latest.drawdown_no, '') as latest_drawdown_no, ifnull(co.collateral_count, 0) as collateral_count, ifnull(co.appraisal_value_total, 0) as appraisal_value_total, ifnull(co.confirmed_value_total, 0) as confirmed_value_total, ifnull(co_latest.collateral_no, '') as latest_collateral_no, ifnull(rel.contract_collateral_count, 0) as contract_collateral_count, ifnull(rel.total_secured_amount, 0) as total_secured_amount, ifnull(ex.exposure_count, 0) as exposure_count, ifnull(ex.exposure_balance_total, 0) as exposure_balance_total, ifnull(ex.ead_amount_total, 0) as ead_amount_total, ex.max_pd, ex.max_lgd_avg, ex.max_lgd_downturn, ifnull(ex.el_avg_total, 0) as el_avg_total, ifnull(ex_latest.exposure_no, '') as latest_exposure_no, ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(ov.overdue_total_amount, 0) as overdue_total_amount, ifnull(ov.overdue_max_days, 0) as overdue_max_days, ifnull(ov_latest.overdue_no, '') as latest_overdue_no, ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) as debt_default_count, ifnull(dd.default_principal_amount_total, 0) as default_principal_amount_total, ifnull(dd.default_exposure_amount_total, 0) as default_exposure_amount_total, case dd.highest_default_rank when 1 then 'A' when 2 then 'B' when 3 then 'C' else null end as highest_default_level, ifnull(dd_latest.debt_default_no, '') as latest_debt_default_no, ifnull(cd_latest.customer_default_no, '') as customer_default_no, cd_latest.default_status as customer_default_status, ifnull(cd_latest.active_default_debt_count, 0) as customer_default_active_debt_count, ifnull(cd_latest.total_default_debt_count, 0) as customer_default_total_debt_count, cd_latest.highest_default_level as customer_default_level, cd_latest.latest_default_date as customer_default_latest_default_date, case when ifnull(cd_latest.default_status, '') = 'ACTIVE' then 'HIGH' when ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) > 0 then 'HIGH' when ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) > 0 or ifnull(ov.overdue_max_days, 0) > 30 then 'MEDIUM' when ifnull(ex.max_pd, 0) >= 0.05 then 'MEDIUM' else c.risk_level end as ledger_risk_level
order by case when ifnull(cd_latest.default_status, '') = 'ACTIVE' then 1 when ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) > 0 then 2 when ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) > 0 then 3 when ifnull(ex.max_pd, 0) >= 0.05 then 4 else 5 end, c.customer_no limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
